Production SSH/SLURM Scheduler Backend

Source: R/backend_ssh.R
SlurmSshBackend.Rd

Orchestrates remote SLURM array jobs over SSH/SCP with zero dependency on ZeroMQ or open worker ports. Stages self-contained bundles (payload.rds, chunks.rds, standalone worker.R, and submit.sbatch), submits array jobs with sbatch --parsable, reconciles live squeue and sacct telemetry, performs surgical retries of failed array indices with optional --mem / --time scaling, and retrieves completed checkpoints via scp.

Accepts an injectable command_runner callback (defaulting to processx::run) and dry_run = TRUE mode so every SSH/SLURM workflow can be verified offline in contract and snapshot tests.

Logical; if TRUE, stages bundles locally and records commands without executing SSH/SCP.

Non-negative integer transient SSH/SCP retry limit (default 2L).

ssh_retry_base_sec

Base delay in seconds for bounded exponential SSH backoff (default 0.5).

ssh_retry_max_sec

Maximum backoff delay cap in seconds (default 8.0).

command_runner

Function (cmd, args) returning list(status, stdout, stderr).

SlurmSshBackend$new()

Create a new SlurmSshBackend.

Usage

SlurmSshBackend$new(
  host,
  user = NULL,
  remote_dir = "~/slurmpilot_jobs",
  local_stage_dir = NULL,
  port = 22L,
  ssh_key = NULL,
  ssh_options = character(),
  partition = NULL,
  account = NULL,
  qos = NULL,
  container_sif = NULL,
  container_binds = character(),
  modules = character(),
  dry_run = FALSE,
  ssh_max_retries = 2L,
  ssh_retry_base_sec = 0.5,
  ssh_retry_max_sec = 8,
  command_runner = NULL
)

Arguments

host

Remote SLURM cluster hostname.

user

Optional SSH username.

remote_dir

Base remote workspace directory. Default "~/slurmpilot_jobs".

local_stage_dir

Local staging directory. Defaults to a temporary directory.

port

SSH port integer. Default 22L.

ssh_key

Optional private SSH key path.

ssh_options

Optional extra SSH options.

partition

Optional default SLURM --partition.

account

Optional default SLURM --account.

qos

Optional default SLURM --qos.

container_sif

Optional remote path to Apptainer .sif image.

container_binds

Optional character vector of Apptainer bind mounts.

modules

Optional character vector of HPC modules to load.

dry_run

Logical; record commands without making network calls. Default FALSE.

ssh_max_retries

Non-negative integer retries on transient SSH/SCP transport errors. Default 2L.

ssh_retry_base_sec

Base backoff delay in seconds. Default 0.5.

ssh_retry_max_sec

Maximum backoff delay cap in seconds. Default 8.0.

command_runner

Optional runner function(cmd, args) overriding processx::run.

Examples

ssh <- SlurmSshBackend$new(host = "hpc.example.edu", user = "researcher", dry_run = TRUE)
print(ssh)
#> <<SlurmSshBackend>> target=researcher@hpc.example.edu,
#> remote_dir=~/slurmpilot_jobs, dry_run=TRUE
unlink(ssh$local_stage_dir, recursive = TRUE)
